reports.desc: Was looking to find dachshund puppy that they would deliver to me. I didn’t trust to send money through Chime or other sites. Told them I was willing to drive to their location and pay cash in full the very next day. They still demanded a deposit to hold puppy. They would not tell me location or avoided the subject of where they are located.

I searched for passport renewal online and believed I was on the Dept of State website. It was the first search result that came up.
I put in SSN, address and old passport # for both my husband and I. We paid $296 each. A few days later, my husband received an envelope in the mail with a filled out DS-82 with his information and the photo we submitted online, along with a check for $130 made out to the Dept of State so that he can sign and submit the application. This is how we figured out the scam.
Several days later and I have not received anything for my application.

I purchased a Chicago Bears Sweater Vest based on images on Happy Nest. I ordered an XL. The item was extremely small and it was not a sweater at all. It was like a sweatshirt vest with BEARS printed on it. It was just awful. Bad fit and not as pictured or described.
I started sending emails and they keep asking for photos and measurements. I keep sending photos and measurements and they just keep asking for more. It's a total scam. They will probably never give me a refund even though I have expressed dissatisfaction. I am reporting them because they refuse to refund or allow returns.

I purchased the items in July they refunded my money. Then They tried to debit my card November 13, and the bank declined. They called me said I had a subscription, I didn’t, said I owed 200. I said no I don’t have a subscription then they said they would keep billing me monthly. They would not cancel unless I paid 143.00. My bank advised me to settle. So I said ok. Gave them my card info he said wait. Then came back and said everything processed and my subscription was cancelled.
I asked for confirmation of the debit. 383.00! I said I did not agree to that amount. I called my bank and they said it’s not fraud because you agreed to 143 dollars. I said, yeah, but they charged me $383. How is that not fraud. So now I have to wait until it posts to my account and then dispute the charge. Save yourself the aggravation. do not buy cardio flush under any circumstances. The product is garbage and the customer service is a scam.

Placed an order and almost immediately (within 15 mins.) I realized the site was questionable because of lack of readable reviews and no serviceable phone number for customer service, only a email listed. Shortly thereafter, around 15 mins, a email came saying the order was shipped. I have since seen a lot of information on line that leads me to believe this company is ripping people off and should be shut down.
